name: Devices licensed for an area with no site, whose band overlaps the signal
sql: SELECT d.FREQUENCY AS center_hz, d.BANDWIDTH AS bandwidth_hz, TRIM(d.EMISSION) AS emission, d.DEVICE_TYPE AS device_type, d.TRANSMITTER_POWER AS power, d.TRANSMITTER_POWER_UNIT AS power_unit, d.EIRP AS eirp, d.EIRP_UNIT AS eirp_unit, a.GAIN AS gain_dbi, d.AZIMUTH AS azimuth_deg, a.H_BEAMWIDTH AS beamwidth_deg, a.FRONT_TO_BACK AS front_to_back_db, d.HEIGHT AS height_m, d.TILT AS tilt_deg, d.POLARISATION AS polarisation, d.CALL_SIGN AS callsign, cs.DESCRIPTION AS station_class, ns.DESCRIPTION AS nature_of_service, d.HOURS_OF_OPERATION AS hours, d.LICENCE_NO AS licence_no, sv.SV_NAME AS service, ss.SS_NAME AS subservice, l.STATUS AS licence_status, l.DATE_ISSUED AS issued, l.DATE_OF_EXPIRY AS expires, c.LICENCEE AS licensee, c.TRADING_NAME AS trading_name, ic.NAME AS industry, ct.NAME AS client_type, d.AREA_DESCRIPTION AS area FROM device_details d LEFT JOIN antenna a ON a.ANTENNA_ID = d.ANTENNA_ID LEFT JOIN class_of_station cs ON cs.CODE = d.CLASS_OF_STATION_CODE LEFT JOIN nature_of_service ns ON ns.CODE = d.NATURE_OF_SERVICE_ID LEFT JOIN licence l ON l.LICENCE_NO = d.LICENCE_NO LEFT JOIN licence_service sv ON sv.SV_ID = l.SV_ID LEFT JOIN licence_subservice ss ON ss.SS_ID = l.SS_ID LEFT JOIN client c ON c.CLIENT_NO = l.CLIENT_NO LEFT JOIN industry_cat ic ON ic.CAT_ID = c.CAT_ID LEFT JOIN client_type ct ON ct.TYPE_ID = c.CLIENT_TYPE_ID WHERE d.FREQUENCY - COALESCE(d.BANDWIDTH, 0) / 2 <= {hi_hz} AND d.FREQUENCY + COALESCE(d.BANDWIDTH, 0) / 2 >= {lo_hz} AND d.SITE_ID IS NULL ORDER BY d.FREQUENCY, d.LICENCE_NO
